name: Tennoudai Mutsumi
source:
She met Tomiaki at her part-time job, and they eventually became engaged.
Perhaps because she was unaware of the relationship between Tomiaki and Koharu, she was a remarkably oblivious girl who thought nothing of it, even when told that the two of them were already acquainted.
